change_zh: DALL·E 2 发布（扩散模型，更高分辨率，支持 inpainting）

change_zh: Stable Diffusion 以开放权重公开发布

change: SDXL 1.0 open release
change_zh: SDXL 1.0 开放发布

change: DALL·E 3 announced, integrated with ChatGPT
change_zh: DALL·E 3 发布，并集成进 ChatGPT

change: Native image generation in GPT-4o / ChatGPT

change: Viral image gen/edit model: multi-image blending, character consistency, NL edits

change: V8.1: V7-like aesthetic, HD 3x faster/cheaper, image prompts back
